title: Under the supply
prompt: It is 09:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: A clean entry on the 5m, in a downtrend on the larger timeframes, with a clear area above price. Think about what each option would have to assume.

whyNot.label: targeting beyond the supply
whyNot.why: The 1H gap above is exactly where a downtrend wants to sell. A long that aims through it is asking the trend to stop on a 5m signal.

whyNot.label: shorting the supply from here
whyNot.why: Price is still a hundred points below it. Nothing has reached the area, and a short needs a sweep and displacement at it.

reference.summary: A valid 5m long in a Daily and 4H downtrend, with 1H supply about a hundred points above. Two defensible answers: stand aside, or take it with the target just under the supply and accept a lower reward. A target beyond the supply is the mistake.

bias.why: Lower highs and lower lows on the Daily and 4H. The bounce is inside the downtrend, up to supply.

decision.why: Either is defensible: stand aside because the trade fights the trend, or take a counter-trend scalp to a clearly-bounded target. The first is lower risk; the second must be priced as what it is.

take.why: A valid counter-trend scalp; a pass is also fine.

draw.why: The higher timeframe is drawn down. The long is a retrace to supply.

annotations.label: 1H bearish FVG above price
annotations.why: Higher-timeframe supply. The ceiling on any long: a target belongs under it, not through it.
annotations.decisionNote: The room to the supply sets the reward and says what this trade is: a scalp inside a downtrend.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: A valid entry model if you take the long.

annotations.label: Low of the overnight drop 20,802.5
annotations.why: The liquidity swept at the open.

annotations.label: Previous day low 20,965.5
annotations.why: Where the higher timeframe is aimed.

confluences.label: Sell-side liquidity swept
confluences.why: Real; it makes the scalp valid.

confluences.label: "The 5m trend is up"
confluences.why: A 5m move inside a Daily downtrend is a retrace.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed above the last 5m high

lookFor: Name the ceiling before the entry. Here the room is about 120 points: a scalp, not a trend trade.
A target under supply is a plan. A target through it is a hope.
Both 'no trade' and 'scalp to the supply' are right here; what's not is pretending it's a trend trade.
